comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
Someone have a better description of this skill?
Works only for trade goods or for equips and consumables too?
Works on PVP?
Works for plunder rare items like the Ship Engineer's Treasure Chest?
Do you get a message specifically saying you earned something throught your pet?

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
No trade goods, nothing rare.
Dont know about PvP.
You get stuff similar to the "area search" pet skill, like RIBs, fire buckets, POs, spare Sails, life savers... etc. lot of different stuff.
I have the feeling you get the same stuff a pet with "area search" would also get in that sea zone, but i might be wrong, have not tested it properly yet.
You get a message that your pet found X, again similar to pet search.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This randomly triggers after the conclusion of a sea battle and you have a chance for getting one of four possible items in that sea region to drop in your inventory, presuming you have slots for them. No effect on PVP gains or rare item plunder from NPCs. Land plundering works the same.

And yes, area search yields the same result, but is much easier since it doesn't require you to defeat an NPC fleet each time for a chance at getting the regional item drop.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Side note for later removal: I believe that the pet skill descriptions will be updated soon to English. Apologies for the confusion until that happens.
